note: GH-9: protect the default branch. A person merges the final pull request. The builder never pushes to this branch. Do not apply until the team confirms Git Sync can push through protection (ADR 0008, task 17).
steps: Do not apply until the team confirms Git Sync can push through protection (ADR 0008, task 17).
Open the repository settings on GitHub, then Branches.
Add a protection rule for the default branch.
Require a pull request with 1 approval and a review by the code owners listed in .github/CODEOWNERS.
Require the status checks verify and evals to pass, on an up-to-date branch.
Block force pushes and branch deletion. Apply the rule to administrators.
